345: struct_with_invariants!{
346: pub tracked struct ContextGhost<DT: Dispatch> {
347:     pub batch_perms: Option<PointsTo<PendingOperation<DT>>>,
348: 
349:     pub slots: FlatCombiner::slots,
350: 
351:     pub update: Option<UnboundedLog::local_updates<DT>>
352: }
353: 
354: pub open spec fn inv(&self, v: u64, tid: nat, cell: PCell<PendingOperation<DT>>, fc: FlatCombiner::Instance, inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>) -> bool {
355:     predicate {
356:         &&& self.slots.key() == tid
357:         &&& self.slots.instance_id() == fc.id()
358: 
359:         &&& ((v == 0) || (v == 1))
360:         &&& (v == 0 ==> self.slots.value().is_Empty() || self.slots.value().is_Response())
361:         &&& (v == 1 ==> self.slots.value().is_Request() || self.slots.value().is_InProgress())
362: 
363:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Empty() ==> {
364:             &&& self.update.is_none()
365:             &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
366:         })
367: 
368:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Request() ==> {
369:             &&& self.update matches Some(update)
370:             &&& update.value().is_Init()
371:             &&& update.key() == self.slots.value().get_ReqId()
372:             &&& update.instance_id() == inst.id()
373: 
374:             &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
375:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_init()
376:             &&& batch_perms@.pcell == cell.id()
377:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().value().op == update.value().get_Init_op()
378:         })
379: 
380:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_InProgress() ==> {
381:             &&& self.update.is_none()
382:             &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
383:         })
384: 
385:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Response() ==> {
386:             &&& self.update matches Some(update)
387:             &&& update.value().is_Done()
388:             &&& update.key() == self.slots.value().get_ReqId()
389:             &&& update.instance_id() == inst.id()
390: 
391:             &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
392:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_init()
393:             &&& batch_perms@.pcell == cell.id()
394:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().value().resp matches Some(resp)
395:             &&& resp == update.value().get_Done_ret()
396:         })
397:     }
398: }
399: }

402: pub tracked struct FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT: Dispatch> {
403:     pub tracked batch_perms: Option<PointsTo<PendingOperation<DT>>>,
404:     pub tracked cell_id: Ghost<CellId>,
405:     pub tracked local_updates: Option<UnboundedLog::local_updates<DT>>,
406:     pub tracked fc_clients: FlatCombiner::clients,
407: }
408: 
409: impl<DT: Dispatch> FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT> {
410:     pub open spec fn enqueue_op_pre(
411:         &self,
412:         tid: nat,
413:         op: DT::WriteOperation,
414:         batch_cell: CellId,
415:         fc_inst: FlatCombiner::Instance,
416:         inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>,
417:     ) -> bool {
418:         &&& self.local_updates matches Some(local_updates)
419:         &&& local_updates.instance_id() == inst.id()
420:         &&& local_updates.value().is_Init()
421:         &&& local_updates.value().get_Init_op() == op
422:         &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
423:         &&& batch_perms@.pcell == self.cell_id
424:         &&& self.cell_id == batch_cell
425:         &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_uninit()
426:         &&& self.fc_clients.instance_id() == fc_inst.id()
427:         &&& self.fc_clients.key() == tid
428:         &&& self.fc_clients.value().is_Idle()
429:     }
430: 
431:     pub open spec fn enqueue_op_post(&self, pre: FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT>) -> bool
432:         recommends
433:             pre.local_updates.is_some(),
434:     {
435:         &&& self.fc_clients.value().is_Waiting()
436:         &&& self.fc_clients.value().get_Waiting_0() == pre.local_updates.unwrap().key()
437:         &&& self.fc_clients.instance_id() == pre.fc_clients.instance_id()
438:         &&& self.fc_clients.key() == pre.fc_clients.key()
439:         &&& self.cell_id == pre.cell_id
440:         &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
441:         &&& self.local_updates.is_none()
442:     }
443: 
444:     pub open spec fn dequeue_resp_pre(
445:         &self,
446:         batch_cell: CellId,
447:         tid: nat,
448:         fc_inst: FlatCombiner::Instance,
449:     ) -> bool {
450:         &&& self.fc_clients.key() == tid
451:         &&& self.fc_clients.instance_id() == fc_inst.id()
452:         &&& self.fc_clients.value().is_Waiting()
453:         &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
454:         &&& self.local_updates.is_none()
455:         &&& self.cell_id == batch_cell
456:     }
457: 
458:     pub open spec fn dequeue_resp_post(
459:         &self,
460:         pre: FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT>,
461:         ret: Option<DT::Response>,
462:         inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>,
463:     ) -> bool {
464:         &&& ret matches Some(ret) ==> {
465:             &&& self.cell_id == pre.cell_id
466:             &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
467:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_uninit()
468:             &&& batch_perms@.pcell == self.cell_id
469:             &&& self.local_updates matches Some(local_updates)
470:             &&& local_updates.instance_id() == inst.id()
471:             &&& local_updates.value().is_Done()
472:             &&& local_updates.key() == pre.fc_clients.value().get_Waiting_0()
473:             &&& local_updates.value().get_Done_ret() == ret
474:             &&& self.fc_clients.instance_id() == pre.fc_clients.instance_id()
475:             &&& self.fc_clients.key() == pre.fc_clients.key()
476:             &&& self.fc_clients.value().is_Idle()
477:         }
478:         &&& ret.is_none() ==> {
479:             &&& self == pre
480:         }
481:     }
482: }

484: }

579:         &&& self.slog.len() == LOG_SIZE

581:         &&& self.slog.len() == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.cell_ids().len()
582:         &&& (forall |i| #![trigger self.slog[i]] 0 <= i < self.slog.len() ==> {
583:             &&& self.slog[i].log_entry.id() == (#[trigger]self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.cell_ids()[i])

585: 
586:         &&& (forall |i: nat| i < LOG_SIZE ==> (#[trigger] self.slog[i as int]).wf(i, self.cyclic_buffer_instance@))
587: 
588:         &&& self.unbounded_log_instance@.num_replicas() == self.num_replicas
589:         &&& self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.num_replicas() == self.num_replicas
590:         &&& self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.unbounded_log_instance() == self.unbounded_log_instance
591:     }
592: 
593:     invariant on version_upper_bound with (unbounded_log_instance) specifically (self.version_upper_bound.0) is (v: u64, g: UnboundedLog::version_upper_bound<DT>) {
594:         &&& g.instance_id() == unbounded_log_instance@.id()

600:         &&& g.instance_id() == cyclic_buffer_instance@.id()
601:         &&& g.value() == v

605:     invariant on tail with (cyclic_buffer_instance, unbounded_log_instance) specifically (self.tail.0) is (v: u64, g: (UnboundedLog::tail<DT>, CyclicBuffer::tail<DT>)) {
606:         &&& g.0.instance_id() == unbounded_log_instance@.id()
607:         &&& g.0.value() == v
608:         &&& g.1.instance_id() == cyclic_buffer_instance@.id()
609:         &&& g.1.value() == v

616:         specifically (self.local_versions@[i].0)

619:         &&& g.0.instance_id() == unbounded_log_instance@.id()

621:         &&& g.0.value() == v

623:         &&& g.1.key() == i

651:         let tracked mut ul_local_versions: Map<NodeId, UnboundedLog::local_versions<DT>>;
652:         let tracked ul_version_upper_bound: UnboundedLog::version_upper_bound<DT>;
653:         let tracked ul_combiner: Map<NodeId, UnboundedLog::combiner<DT>>;
654:         proof {
655:             let tracked (
656:                 Tracked(unbounded_log_instance0),  
657:                 Tracked(ul_log0),  
658:                 Tracked(ul_tail0),  
659:                 Tracked(ul_replicas0),  
660:                 Tracked(ul_local_versions0),  
661:                 Tracked(ul_version_upper_bound0),  
662:                 _,  
663:                 _,  
664:                 Tracked(ul_combiner0),

667:             ul_tail = ul_tail0;
668:             ul_replicas = ul_replicas0.into_map();
669:             ul_local_versions = ul_local_versions0.into_map();
670:             ul_version_upper_bound = ul_version_upper_bound0;
671:             ul_combiner = ul_combiner0.into_map();
672:         }
673:         let ghost mut logical_log_idx;
674:         proof {
675:             logical_log_idx = -log_size as int;
676:         }
677:         let mut slog_entries: Vec<Option<PCell<Option<ConcreteLogEntry<DT>>>>> = Vec::with_capacity(
678:             log_size,
679:         );

682:         let mut log_idx = 0;

701:                         unbounded_log_instance,
702:                     ),
703:             decreases log_size - log_idx

705:             let (pcell, token) = PCell::new(Option::None);

707:                 cell_ids = cell_ids.push(pcell.id());

723:         let tracked cyclic_buffer_instance: CyclicBuffer::Instance<DT>;
724:         let tracked cb_head: CyclicBuffer::head<DT>;
725:         let tracked cb_tail: CyclicBuffer::tail<DT>;
726:         let tracked mut cb_local_versions: Map<NodeId, CyclicBuffer::local_versions<DT>>;
727:         let tracked mut cb_alive_bits: Map<LogIdx, CyclicBuffer::alive_bits<DT>>;

730:             let tracked (
731:                 Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance0),  
732:                 Tracked(cb_head0),  
733:                 Tracked(cb_tail0),  
734:                 Tracked(cb_local_versions0),  
735:                 Tracked(cb_alive_bits0),  
736:                 Tracked(cb_combiner0),

738:                 log_size as nat,
739:                 num_replicas as nat,

741:                 cell_ids,
742:                 unbounded_log_instance,
743:                 contents,
744:             );
745:             cyclic_buffer_instance = cyclic_buffer_instance0;
746:             cb_head = cb_head0;
747:             cb_tail = cb_tail0;

753:         let mut log_idx = 0;
754:         while log_idx < log_size
755:             invariant
756:                 0 <= log_idx <= log_size,
757:                 slog_entries.len() == log_size,
758:                 slog.len() == log_idx,
759:                 cell_ids.len() == log_size,
760:                 forall|i|
761:                     #![trigger slog[i]]

763:                         &&& slog[i].wf(i as nat, cyclic_buffer_instance)

775:                 forall|i|

794:                 alive: AtomicBool::new(
795:                     Ghost((Ghost(log_idx as nat), cb_inst)),

797:                     Tracked(cb_alive_bit),
798:                 ),
799:                 cyclic_buffer_idx: Ghost(log_idx as nat),
800:                 cyclic_buffer_instance: Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance.clone()),

803:             log_idx = log_idx + 1;
804:         }
805:         let ul_inst = Tracked(unbounded_log_instance.clone());
806:         let version_upper_bound = CachePadded(
807:             AtomicU64::new(Ghost(ul_inst), 0, Tracked(ul_version_upper_bound)),
808:         );
809:         let cb_inst = Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance.clone());
810:         let head = CachePadded(AtomicU64::new(Ghost(cb_inst), 0, Tracked(cb_head)));
811:         let cb_inst = Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance.clone());
812:         let ul_inst = Tracked(unbounded_log_instance.clone());
813:         let tail = CachePadded(
814:             AtomicU64::new(Ghost((cb_inst, ul_inst)), 0, Tracked((ul_tail, cb_tail))),

817:             CachePadded<
818:                 AtomicU64<
819:                     (Tracked<UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>>, Tracked<CyclicBuffer::Instance<DT>>, int),

822:                 >,
823:             >,

843:                         &&& ul_local_versions[i].key() == i
844:                         &&& ul_local_versions[i].value() == 0

848:                     0 <= i < local_versions.len() ==> {

851:                         &&& local_versions[i].0.constant().1 == cyclic_buffer_instance
852:                         &&& local_versions[i].0.constant().2 == i

858:             let tracked cb_version;

868:                     AtomicU64::new(
869:                         Ghost((ul_inst, cb_inst, nid_ghost)),

873:                 ),
874:             );

956:     pub(crate) fn get_version_upper_bound(
957:         &self,
958:         local_reads: Tracked<UnboundedLog::local_reads<DT>>,
959:     ) -> (ret: (u64, Tracked<UnboundedLog::local_reads<DT>>))
960:         requires
961:             self.wf(),
962:             local_reads@.instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id(),
963:             local_reads@.value().is_Init(),
964:         ensures
965:             ret.1@.value().is_VersionUpperBound(),
966:             ret.1@.value().get_VersionUpperBound_version_upper_bound() == ret.0 as nat,
967:             ret.1@.value().get_VersionUpperBound_op() == local_reads@.value().get_Init_op(),
968:             ret.1@.instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id(),
969:             ret.1@.key() == local_reads@.key(),
970:     {
971:         let tracked local_reads = local_reads.get();
972:         let ghost rid = local_reads.key();
973:         let tracked new_local_reads_g: UnboundedLog::local_reads<DT>;
974:         let res =
975:             atomic_with_ghost!(
976:             &self.version_upper_bound.0 => load();
977:             returning res;
978:             ghost g => {
979:                 new_local_reads_g = self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow()
980:                                             .readonly_version_upper_bound(rid, &g, local_reads);
981:             }
982:         );
983:         (res, Tracked(new_local_reads_g))
984:     }

1002:                 == local_reads@.value().get_VersionUpperBound_op(),

1051:     pub fn append(

1060:             self.wf(),
1061:             replica_token@ < self.local_versions.len(),
1062:             old(responses).len() == 0,

1064:                 replica_token@,

1066:                 operations@,
1067:                 self.unbounded_log_instance@,
1068:                 self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
1069:             ),
1070:             operations.len() <= MAX_REQUESTS,

1072:             result@.append_post(

1074:                 replica_token@,

1076:                 operations@,
1077:                 final(responses)@,
1078:                 self.unbounded_log_instance@,
1079:                 self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
1080:             ),
1081:     {

1083:         let nid = replica_token.id() as usize;
1084:         let nops = operations.len();
1085:         let mut iteration = 1;
1086:         let mut waitgc = 1;
1087:         loop
1088:             invariant
1089:                 self.wf(),
1090:                 0 <= waitgc <= WARN_THRESHOLD,
1091:                 0 <= iteration <= WARN_THRESHOLD,
1092:                 responses.len() == 0,
1093:                 replica_token@ < self.local_versions.len(),

1487:                     request_ids,
1488:                 };
1489:                 return Tracked(ghost_data_new);
1490:             }
1491:             let cb_combiner = Tracked(cb_combiner);
1492:             let tracked ghost_data0 = NrLogAppendExecDataGhost {
1493:                 local_updates,
1494:                 ghost_replica,
1495:                 combiner,
1496:                 cb_combiner,
1497:                 request_ids,
1498:             };
1499:             ghost_data_new =
1500:             self.execute(replica_token, responses, actual_replica, Tracked(ghost_data0));

1538:     #[verifier::exec_allows_no_decreases_clause]
1539:     pub(crate) fn execute(
1540:         &self,
1541:         replica_token: &ReplicaToken,
1542:         responses: &mut Vec<DT::Response>,
1543:         actual_replica: &mut DT,
1544:         ghost_data: Tracked<NrLogAppendExecDataGhost<DT>>,
1545:     ) -> (result: Tracked<NrLogAppendExecDataGhost<DT>>)
1546:         requires
1547:             self.wf(),
1548:             replica_token@ < self.local_versions.len(),
1549:             ghost_data@.execute_pre(
1550:                 replica_token@,
1551:                 old(actual_replica).view(),
1552:                 old(responses)@,
1553:                 self.unbounded_log_instance@,
1554:                 self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
1555:             ),
1556:         ensures
1557:             result@.execute_post(
1558:                 ghost_data@,
1559:                 replica_token@,
1560:                 final(actual_replica).view(),
1561:                 old(responses)@,
1562:                 final(responses)@,
1563:                 self.unbounded_log_instance@,
1564:                 self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
1565:             ),
1566:     {
1567:         let nid = replica_token.id() as usize;
1568:         let tracked ghost_data = ghost_data.get();
1569:         let tracked mut local_updates = ghost_data.local_updates.get();  
1570:         let tracked mut ghost_replica = ghost_data.ghost_replica.get();  
1571:         let tracked mut combiner = ghost_data.combiner.get();  
1572:         let tracked mut cb_combiner = ghost_data.cb_combiner.get();  
1573:         let ghost request_ids = ghost_data.request_ids@;  
1574:         let ghost mut request_ids_new = request_ids;
1575:         proof {
1576:             if combiner.value().is_Ready() {
1577:                 combiner =
1578:                 self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow().exec_trivial_start(nid as nat, combiner);
1579:                 request_ids_new = Seq::empty();
1580:             }
1581:         }
1582:         let mut local_version =
1583:             atomic_with_ghost!(
1584:             &self.local_versions[nid].0 => load();
1585:             returning ret;
1586:             ghost g => {
1587:                 combiner = self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow().exec_load_local_version(nid as nat, &g.0, combiner);
1588:                 cb_combiner = self.cyclic_buffer_instance.borrow().reader_start(nid as nat, &g.1, cb_combiner);
1589:             }
1590:         );
1591:         let global_tail =
1592:             atomic_with_ghost!(
1593:             &self.tail.0 => load();
1594:             returning global_tail;
1595:             ghost g => {
1596:                 if (local_version == global_tail) {
1597:                     combiner = self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow().exec_finish_no_change(nid as nat, &g.0, combiner);
1598:                     cb_combiner = self.cyclic_buffer_instance.borrow().reader_abort(nid as nat, cb_combiner);
1599:                 } else {
1600:                     combiner = self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow().exec_load_global_head(nid as nat, &g.0, combiner);
1601:                     cb_combiner = self.cyclic_buffer_instance.borrow().reader_enter(nid as nat,  &g.1, cb_combiner);
1602:                 }
1603:             }
1604:         );
1605:         if local_version == global_tail {
1606:             let tracked ghost_data_ret = NrLogAppendExecDataGhost {
1607:                 local_updates: Tracked(local_updates),  
1608:                 ghost_replica: Tracked(ghost_replica),  
1609:                 combiner: Tracked(combiner),  
1610:                 cb_combiner: Tracked(cb_combiner),  
1611:                 request_ids: Ghost(request_ids),  
1612:             };
1613:             assert(ghost_data_ret.common_pred(
1614:                 replica_token@,
1615:                 actual_replica.view(),
1616:                 self.unbounded_log_instance@,
1617:                 self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
1618:             ));
1619:             return Tracked(ghost_data_ret);
1620:         }
1621: 
1622:         let ghost local_updates_old = local_updates;
1623:         let ghost responses_old = responses@;
1624:         let mut responses_idx: usize = 0;
1625:         while local_version < global_tail
1626:             invariant
1627:                 self.wf(),
1628:                 ghost_data.combiner@.value().is_Placed() ==> {
1629:                     &&& ghost_data.combiner@.value().get_Placed_queued_ops() == request_ids
1630:                     &&& combiner.value().get_Loop_queued_ops() == request_ids
1631:                 },
1632:                 ghost_data.combiner@.value().is_Ready() ==> combiner.value().get_Loop_queued_ops()
1633:                     == Seq::<ReqId>::empty(),
1634:                 combiner.value().queued_ops() == request_ids_new,
1635:                 0 <= local_version <= global_tail,
1636:                 0 <= responses_idx as nat <= request_ids_new.len(),
1637:                 responses_idx == 0 ==> responses@ == responses_old && local_updates
1638:                     == local_updates_old,
1639:                 ghost_data.combiner@.value().is_Placed() ==> responses.len() == responses_idx,
1640:                 request_ids_new.len() <= MAX_REQUESTS,
1641:                 ghost_replica.instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id(),
1642:                 ghost_replica.key() == nid as nat,
1643:                 ghost_replica.value() == actual_replica.view(),
1644:                 cb_combiner.key() == nid as nat,
1645:                 cb_combiner.instance_id() == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.id(),
1646:                 cb_combiner.value().is_Reading(),
1647:                 cb_combiner.value().get_Reading_0().is_Range(),
1648:                 cb_combiner.value().get_Reading_0().get_Range_cur() == local_version,
1649:                 cb_combiner.value().get_Reading_0().get_Range_end() == global_tail,
1650:                 combiner.key() == nid as nat,
1651:                 combiner.instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id(),
1652:                 combiner.value().is_Loop(),
1653:                 combiner.value().get_Loop_queued_ops() == request_ids_new,
1654:                 combiner.value().get_Loop_lversion() == local_version,
1655:                 combiner.value().get_Loop_tail() == global_tail,
1656:                 combiner.value().get_Loop_idx() == responses_idx,
1657:                 forall|i|
1658:                     #![trigger local_updates[i]]
1659:                     responses_idx <= i < request_ids_new.len() ==> {
1660:                         &&& #[trigger ] local_updates.contains_key(i)
1661:                         &&& local_updates[i].key() == request_ids_new[i as int]
1662:                         &&& local_updates[i].value().is_Placed()
1663:                         &&& local_updates[i].instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id()
1664:                     },
1665:                 ghost_data.combiner@.value().is_Placed() ==> forall|i|
1666:                     #![trigger local_updates[i]]
1667:                     0 <= i < responses_idx ==> {
1668:                         &&& #[trigger] local_updates.contains_key(i)
1669:                         &&& local_updates[i].key() == request_ids_new[i as int]
1670:                         &&& local_updates[i].instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id()
1671:                         &&& local_updates[i].value().is_Applied()
1672:                         &&& local_updates[i].value().get_Applied_ret() == responses[i as int]
1673:                         &&& local_updates[i].value().get_Applied_idx()
1674:                             < combiner.value().get_Loop_tail()
1675:                     },
1676:             decreases global_tail - local_version
1677:         {
1678:             let phys_log_idx = self.index(local_version);
1679:             let is_alive_value = self.is_alive_value(local_version);
1680:             let mut iteration = 1;
1681:             let mut is_alive = false;
1682:             while !is_alive
1683:                 invariant
1684:                     self.wf(),
1685:                     local_version < global_tail,
1686:                     phys_log_idx < self.slog.len(),
1687:                     phys_log_idx as nat == self.index_spec(local_version as nat),
1688:                     is_alive_value == self.is_alive_value_spec(local_version as int),
1689:                     0 <= iteration <= WARN_THRESHOLD,
1690:                     cb_combiner.instance_id() == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.id(),
1691:                     cb_combiner.key() == nid as nat,
1692:                     cb_combiner.value().is_Reading(),
1693:                     !is_alive ==> cb_combiner.value().get_Reading_0().is_Range(),
1694:                     !is_alive ==> cb_combiner.value().get_Reading_0().get_Range_cur()
1695:                         == local_version,
1696:                     !is_alive ==> cb_combiner.value().get_Reading_0().get_Range_end() == global_tail,
1697:                     is_alive ==> cb_combiner.value().get_Reading_0().is_Guard(),
1698:                     is_alive ==> cb_combiner.value().get_Reading_0().get_Guard_cur()
1699:                         == local_version,
1700:                     is_alive ==> cb_combiner.value().get_Reading_0().get_Guard_end() == global_tail,
1701:                     self.slog.spec_index(phys_log_idx as int).wf(
1702:                         phys_log_idx as nat,
1703:                         self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
1704:                     ),
1705:             {
1706:                 if iteration == WARN_THRESHOLD {
1707:                     print_starvation_warning(line!());
1708:                     iteration = 0;
1709:                 }
1710:                 let alive_bit =
1711:                     atomic_with_ghost!(
1712:                     &self.slog[phys_log_idx].alive => load();
1713:                     returning alive_bit;
1714:                     ghost g => {
1715:                         if alive_bit == is_alive_value {
1716:                             let tracked (_, Tracked(cb_combiner0)) =
1717:                                 self.cyclic_buffer_instance.borrow().reader_guard(nid as nat, &g, cb_combiner);
1718:                             cb_combiner = cb_combiner0;
1719:                         }
1720:                     });
1721:                 is_alive = alive_bit == is_alive_value;
1722:                 iteration = iteration + 1;
1723:             }
1724: 
1725:             let tracked stored_entry: &StoredType<DT>;
1726:             proof {
1727:                 stored_entry =
1728:                 self.cyclic_buffer_instance.borrow().guard_guards(nid as nat, &cb_combiner);
1729:             }
1730:             let log_entry = self.slog[phys_log_idx].log_entry.borrow(
1731:                 Tracked(&stored_entry.cell_perms),
1732:             );
1733:             let res = actual_replica.dispatch_mut(
1734:                 DT::clone_write_op(&log_entry.as_ref().unwrap().op),
1735:             );
1736:             if log_entry.as_ref().unwrap().node_id == nid as u64 {
1737:                 proof {
1738:                     if let Option::Some(e) = &stored_entry.log_entry {
1739:                         self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow().pre_exec_dispatch_local(
1740:                             nid as nat,
1741:                             e,
1742:                             &combiner,
1743:                         );
1744:                         let tracked local_update = local_updates.tracked_remove(
1745:                             responses_idx as nat,
1746:                         );
1747:                         let tracked (
1748:                             Tracked(ghost_replica0),
1749:                             Tracked(local_update),
1750:                             Tracked(combiner0),
1751:                         ) = self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow().exec_dispatch_local(
1752:                             nid as nat,
1753:                             e,
1754:                             ghost_replica,
1755:                             local_update,
1756:                             combiner,
1757:                         );
1758:                         ghost_replica = ghost_replica0;
1759:                         local_updates.tracked_insert(responses_idx as nat, local_update);
1760:                         combiner = combiner0;
1761:                     } else {
1762:                         assert(false);
1763:                     }
1764:                 }
1765:                 responses.push(res);
1766:                 responses_idx = responses_idx + 1;
1767:             } else {
1768:                 proof {
1769:                     assert(stored_entry.log_entry.unwrap().value().node_id != nid);
1770:                     if let Option::Some(e) = &stored_entry.log_entry {
1771:                         assert(e.value().node_id != nid);
1772:                         let tracked exec_dispatch_remote_result =
1773:                             self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow().exec_dispatch_remote(
1774:                             nid as nat,
1775:                             e,
1776:                             ghost_replica,
1777:                             combiner,
1778:                         );
1779:                         ghost_replica = exec_dispatch_remote_result.0.get();
1780:                         combiner = exec_dispatch_remote_result.1.get();
1781:                     } else {
1782:                         assert(false)  
1783: 
1784:                     }
1785:                 }
1786:             }
1787:             proof {
1788:                 cb_combiner =
1789:                 self.cyclic_buffer_instance.borrow().reader_unguard(nid as nat, cb_combiner);
1790:             }
1791:             local_version = local_version + 1;
1792:         }
1793:         proof {
1794:             self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow().pre_exec_update_version_upper_bound(
1795:                 nid as nat,
1796:                 &combiner,
1797:             );
1798:         }
1799:         atomic_with_ghost!(
1800:             &self.version_upper_bound.0 => fetch_max(global_tail);
1801:             ghost g => {
1802:                 combiner = self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow().exec_update_version_upper_bound(nid as nat, &mut g, combiner);
1803: 
1804:                 if ghost_data.combiner@.value().is_Placed() {
1805:                     local_updates = self.execute_update_done_multiple(request_ids_new,  local_updates, &g);
1806:                 }
1807:             });
1808:         atomic_with_ghost!(
1809:             &self.local_versions[nid].0 => store(global_tail);
1810:             ghost g => {
1811:                 let tracked (Tracked(ul_local_versions), Tracked(ul_combiner))
1812:                     = self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow().exec_finish(nid as nat, g.0, combiner);
1813:                 let tracked (Tracked(cb_local_versions), Tracked(cb_combiner0))
1814:                     = self.cyclic_buffer_instance.borrow().reader_finish(nid as nat, g.1, cb_combiner);
1815: 
1816:                 combiner = ul_combiner;
1817:                 cb_combiner = cb_combiner0;
1818: 
1819:                 g = (ul_local_versions, cb_local_versions);
1820:         });
1821:         let tracked ghost_data_ret = NrLogAppendExecDataGhost {
1822:             local_updates: Tracked(local_updates),  
1823:             ghost_replica: Tracked(ghost_replica),  
1824:             combiner: Tracked(combiner),  
1825:             cb_combiner: Tracked(cb_combiner),

1828:         assert(ghost_data_ret.execute_post(
1829:             ghost_data,
1830:             replica_token@,
1831:             actual_replica.view(),
1832:             old(responses)@,
1833:             responses@,

1840:     pub(crate) fn find_min_local_version(
1841:         &self,
1842:         cb_combiner: Tracked<CyclicBuffer::combiner<DT>>,
1843:     ) -> (result: (u64, Tracked<CyclicBuffer::combiner<DT>>))
1844:         requires
1845:             self.wf(),
1846:             cb_combiner@.instance_id() == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.id(),
1847:             cb_combiner@.value().is_Idle(),
1848:         ensures
1849:             result.0 <= MAX_IDX,
1850:             result.1@.key() == cb_combiner@.key(),
1851:             result.1@.value().is_AdvancingHead(),
1852:             result.1@.instance_id() == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.id(),
1853:             result.1@.value().get_AdvancingHead_idx() == self.num_replicas,
1854:             result.1@.value().get_AdvancingHead_min_local_version() == result.0,
1855:     {
1856:         let num_replicas = self.local_versions.len();
1857:         let tracked mut g_cb_comb_new: CyclicBuffer::combiner<DT> = cb_combiner.get();
1858:         let ghost g_node_id = cb_combiner@.key();
1859:         let mut min_local_version =
1860:             atomic_with_ghost!(
1861:             &self.local_versions[0].0 => load();
1862:             returning ret;
1863:             ghost g => {
1864:                 g_cb_comb_new = self.cyclic_buffer_instance.borrow()
1865:                                         .advance_head_start(g_node_id, &g.1, g_cb_comb_new);
1866:             });
1867:         let mut idx: usize = 1;
1868:         while idx < num_replicas
1869:             invariant
1870:                 self.wf(),
1871:                 0 <= idx <= num_replicas,
1872:                 min_local_version <= MAX_IDX,
1873:                 g_cb_comb_new.instance_id() == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.id(),
1874:                 g_cb_comb_new.value().is_AdvancingHead(),
1875:                 g_cb_comb_new.value().get_AdvancingHead_idx() == idx,
1876:                 g_cb_comb_new.value().get_AdvancingHead_min_local_version() == min_local_version,
1877:                 g_cb_comb_new.key() == g_node_id,
1878:                 num_replicas == self.local_versions.len(),
1879:             decreases num_replicas - idx
1880:         {
1881:             let cur_local_tail =
1882:                 atomic_with_ghost!(
1883:                 &self.local_versions[idx].0 => load();
1884:                 returning ret;
1885:                 ghost g => {
1886:                     g_cb_comb_new = self.cyclic_buffer_instance.borrow()
1887:                                             .advance_head_next(g_node_id, &g.1, g_cb_comb_new);
1888:                 });
1889:             if cur_local_tail < min_local_version {
1890:                 min_local_version = cur_local_tail;
1891:             }
1892:             idx = idx + 1;
1893:         }
1894:         (min_local_version, Tracked(g_cb_comb_new))
1895:     }
1896: }

1911: impl<DT: Dispatch> NrLogAppendExecDataGhost<DT> {
1912:     pub open spec fn common_pred(
1913:         &self,
1914:         nid: NodeId,
1915:         data: DT::View,
1916:         inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>,
1917:         cb_inst: CyclicBuffer::Instance<DT>,
1918:     ) -> bool {
1919:         &&& (forall|i| #![all_triggers]
1920:             0 <= i < self.request_ids@.len() ==> {
1921:                 &&& (self.local_updates@.contains_key(i))
1922:                 &&& self.local_updates@[i].instance_id() == inst.id()
1923:             })
1924:         &&& self.ghost_replica@.key() == nid
1925:         &&& self.ghost_replica@.instance_id() == inst.id()
1926:         &&& self.ghost_replica@.value() == data
1927:         &&& self.combiner@.key() == nid
1928:         &&& self.combiner@.instance_id() == inst.id()
1929:         &&& self.cb_combiner@.key() == nid
1930:         &&& self.cb_combiner@.instance_id() == cb_inst.id()
1931:         &&& self.request_ids@.len() <= MAX_REQUESTS
1932:     }

1934:     pub open spec fn append_pre(
1935:         &self,
1936:         nid: NodeId,
1937:         data: DT::View,
1938:         ops: Seq<DT::WriteOperation>,
1939:         inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>,
1940:         cb_inst: CyclicBuffer::Instance<DT>,
1941:     ) -> bool {
1942:         &&& self.common_pred(nid, data, inst, cb_inst)
1943:         &&& (forall|i|
1944:             #![trigger self.local_updates@[i]]
1945:             0 <= i < self.request_ids@.len() ==> {
1946:                 &&& #[trigger] self.local_updates@.contains_key(i)
1947:                 &&& self.local_updates@[i].key() == self.request_ids@[i as int]
1948:                 &&& self.local_updates@[i].value().is_Init()
1949:                 &&& self.local_updates@[i].value().get_Init_op() == ops[i as int]
1950:             })
1951:         &&& self.combiner@.value().is_Ready()
1952:         &&& self.cb_combiner@.value().is_Idle()
1953:         &&& self.request_ids@.len() == ops.len()
1954:     }

1956:     pub open spec fn append_post(
1957:         &self,
1958:         pre: Self,
1959:         nid: NodeId,
1960:         data: DT::View,
1961:         operations: Seq<DT::WriteOperation>,
1962:         responses: Seq<DT::Response>,
1963:         inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>,
1964:         cb_inst: CyclicBuffer::Instance<DT>,
